types.grid: a list video: every item at once, the video's own things in a grid, a 2-4 word headline
types.ladder: a levels video: the whole ladder, coloured columns rising, a level chip on each
types.extremes: rich vs poor: the two ends of the scale facing each other, one huge word each
types.face: a secret or a warning: one face very big, one strong expression, 2-3 huge words
types.scene: a story: one dramatic still of the video, no or one word
